cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：电动的
cards.example_en: The electric fan kept our classroom bearable in June.
cards.example_zh: 电风扇让我们的教室在六月还能待下去。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Lightning cut the electricity, and we finished dinner by torchlight.
cards.example_zh: 闪电把电切断了，我们打着手电筒吃完了晚餐。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：紧急情况

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The battery holds enough energy to run the lamp for three hours.
cards.example_zh: 这块电池的能量足够让灯亮三个小时。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：发动机
cards.example_en: Smoke from the engine forced the driver to pull off the road.
cards.example_zh: 发动机冒烟，司机只好把车停到路边。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The new sports facility lets us swim even when the outdoor pool is shut.
cards.example_zh: 有了新的体育设施，室外泳池关闭时我们也能游泳。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: She kept her faith in her partner after they lost the opening set.
cards.example_zh: 首盘输掉之后，她对搭档仍然有信心。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: Please forgive me for being late.

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: A guy on the train helped me lift the heavy box.
cards.example_zh: 火车上一个家伙帮我抬起了那个重箱子。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: New hardware arrived for the computer room on Monday.
cards.example_zh: 星期一，电脑室到了一批新硬件。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：实验室
cards.example_en: We heated the liquid in the laboratory during chemistry class.
cards.example_zh: 化学课上，我们在实验室里加热了那种液体。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: This flat land is used for growing wheat and corn.
cards.example_zh: 这片平坦的土地用来种小麦和玉米。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: The recipe needs a litre of milk and two eggs.
cards.example_zh: 这个食谱需要一升牛奶和两个鸡蛋。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: City living can be noisy, but the shops stay open late.
cards.example_zh: 城市生活可能很吵，但商店会开到很晚。

cards.scene: 科学技术 · Science and Technology
cards.example_en: We had a lot of fun at the park.
cards.example_zh: 我们在公园玩得很开心。
